title: Resend 郵件服務正式化 — 網域驗證 + 錯誤處理 + 監控
content:
將 PR-003 建立的 SES 郵件發送改為 Resend，並將寄件流程正式化為可監控、可復原的生產品質。AD-009 先完成 Resend 帳戶、寄件網域與 repo 環境設定；本卡負責之後的程式整合。閒置 SES 設定與 AWS 元件保留至 AWS-001 清理。

任務：
1. Resend 發送整合 (src/lib/email/send.ts)
   - 使用 AD-009 準備好的已驗證網域、API key 與寄件設定，接上 Nodemailer Resend SMTP transport（smtp.resend.com）
   - 沿用現有 HTML、雙語內容、核准流程、BCC 與 PDF Buffer 附件；若 AD-009 確認審計副本使用獨立信箱，讀取 APP_EMAIL_AUDIT_BCC
   - 確認單筆及批次核准流程均透過 Resend 發送；寄件失敗不回滾已完成的核准／收據流程

2. 錯誤處理強化
   - 依 Resend 帳戶方案實作速率限制；Free 方案需遵守每月 3,000 封及每日 100 封上限
   - 建立經簽章驗證的 Resend webhook，接收送達、退信及投訴事件
   - 退信／投訴地址標記為不可寄送，避免後續重複寄信
   - 重試暫時性失敗（最多 3 次、指數退避），永久性錯誤不重試
   - APP_RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET 只存於 server-side 環境；不得提交、回傳或記錄憑證

3. 郵件記錄 (EmailLog 模型)
   - 新增 Prisma model: EmailLog
   - 欄位：id, to, subject, templateName, status (SENT/FAILED/DELIVERED/BOUNCED/COMPLAINT), sentAt, errorMessage, providerMessageId
   - 管理端可檢視郵件發送與 webhook 狀態記錄

4. 前置設定與舊設定界線
   - 讀取 AD-009 定義的 APP_RESEND_API_KEY、APP_EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS、APP_EMAIL_FROM_NAME、APP_EMAIL_REPLY_TO 與（如已確認）APP_EMAIL_AUDIT_BCC
   - Resend webhook 建立後，將 APP_RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET 設入 server-side 環境
   - 本卡不再修改 .env.example、README 或 Amplify 基礎設定；保留 APP_SES_* 設定，待 AWS-001 在本卡驗收後清理

⚠️ 依賴 AD-009 的 Resend 帳戶、寄件網域與環境設定，以及 PR-003 的現有 src/lib/email/ 程式碼。
acceptance: Resend sending domain verified and SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks pass
Nodemailer sends through Resend SMTP to a real external recipient
Receipt email retains bilingual content, admin BCC, and PDF attachment
Resend webhook signature is verified before delivery/bounce/complaint events are processed
Email sending has retry logic (3 attempts with exponential backoff)
Bounce and complaint handling via signed Resend webhooks
EmailLog records every sent email with status
Rate limiting respects the configured Resend plan and its published quotas
Resend failure does not block main user flow (graceful degradation)
Resend secrets are consumed only in server-side code and never exposed or logged
Admin can view email logs from admin panel
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/lib/email/send.ts (refactor — add retry, rate limiting, logging)
src/dictionaries/types.ts (update — add email log dict keys)
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && send a receipt through Resend SMTP to an external test inbox; verify PDF + BCC; deliver signed Resend webhook fixtures for delivered/bounced/complaint; confirm EmailLog status changes and retry/plan limits behave as specified.
